# Vanth Labs

> Vanth Labs builds AI that has a body and stays on your machine. Its product, Hannah, is an open source AI assistant with a voice, a 3D body and hands: she runs on your own computer, talks back in real time, gestures while she speaks, and acts on your machine with your permission. MIT-licensed. One command to install on Linux, macOS and Windows. Founded in 2026 in Lima, Peru.

## Pages

- [Hannah](https://vanthlabs.org/): what she does, requirements, install command, FAQ
- [About Vanth Labs](https://vanthlabs.org/about/): what we believe, who we are, how to work with us
- [Brand and press kit](https://vanthlabs.org/brand/): logos, colors, naming, official paragraph, screenshots
